X1.evidence: Procedure: LLMs: Gemini 3, Grok 4.1 and DeepSeek 3.2 were run with the same prompt and default settings; 40 independent prompts per model. The 20-per-context split is the experimental condition.

X2.evidence: Exploratory analyses: Inter-model comparisons: LLM type had significant ANOVA main effects for severity, F(2, 117) = 5.98, and RJ support, F(2, 117) = 4.55; model pairwise differences were quantified.

X3.evidence: Exploratory analyses: Context × LLM tests examined interactions with the experimental condition; no source-by-source interaction between varied simulation-uncertainty sources was estimated or shown.

notes: Repeated outputs were collected in separate sessions, but run-to-run variation was not reported or analyzed as a design factor; under the brief, R is not counted.
